title: Meta-router for staged speculative commit with kernel-fingerprint-aware routing and fallback playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a lightweight meta-router that performs staged speculative commit decisions using fused signals: kernel fingerprint (hardware/kernel affinity), prefix warm-start score, early-token acceptance estimate, and SLO budget. The router must produce a deterministic routing decision within the prefill window and trigger a safe, low-cost fallback path when acceptance confidence is low or kernel mismatch risk is high.
background: We currently have multiple isolated efforts: kernel-aware scheduler, prefill probes, and acceptance heuristics. These components behave independently which causes suboptimal routing decisions for speculative decoding: mismatched kernel selection causes slow fallbacks and wasted compute; low-confidence early outputs sometimes lead to rollbacks with poor telemetry. This ticket unifies routing logic into a meta-router with explicit acceptance metrics and a documented fallback playbook.
proposed_solution: Introduce a staged decision pipeline inside the runtime: (1) fast prefill estimator that computes acceptance probability and prefix KV-hit score; (2) kernel-fingerprint lookup mapping model+sequence profile to preferred kernels/quantization levels; (3) a cost-aware selector that weighs latency SLO, estimated acceptance, and kernel fit to pick a speculative target; (4) commit/soft-commit interface: speculative outputs are flagged and either committed or retracted based on mid-decode acceptance signals; (5) fallback playbook invoking a prioritized sequence of compatible model variants or CPU fallback with graceful degrade.
acceptance_criteria: Meta-router picks target in < 6ms (median) for 95% of requests in synthetic prefill workload
End-to-end speculative success rate improves by >= 7 percentage points on conversational workload A compared to baseline
Fallback median recovery latency from initial decision < 40ms for GPU->GPU model swap, < 150ms for GPU->CPU fallback
No regression on P99 latency SLO for critical tier (measured over 24h test harness)
Unit tests for decision logic and integration smoke tests for fallback paths added to runtime CI

dependencies: ENG-841999 (prefill confidence operationalizer) - needs prefill estimator hooks
ENG-705321 (fallback scheduler) - early integration for prioritized fallbacks
telemetry_requirements: Emit routing.decision, routing.score.acceptance, routing.score.kernel_fit, routing.latency. Tag traces with model_variant, kernel_id, sequence_length_bucket. Add counter for fallback_reason and fallback_path. Retain for 30 days in staging, 90 days in production.
rollout_plan: Start with staging run using 10% of non-critical traffic (internal test orgs). Monitor acceptance/confidence and fallback rates for 48h. If acceptance rate < baseline -5pts or fallback > 2% escalate to rollback. Gradually increase to 50% then 100% after 2 successful days. Use canary toggles to force fallback paths for validation.
